Labs","details":"Third member of the family, replacing neither. `ForceDeallocateMorphoHook` takes one market;      `ForceDeallocateMorphoVaultHook` reads the whole list but stops at the vault's idle balance.SIZED IN SHARES (SUP-21849). Superman sizes this hop in shares (effect SHARES -> ASSETS), so offset 52      is the share input `S`. The pulls still move UNDERLYING; the last call is `redeem(S - P)` where `P` is      the penalty shares the pulls burn, so a full-balance exit leaves zero shares. `withdraw(assets)` would      burn `previewWithdraw(assets)`, which is not the leftover balance, and shares would remain.THE SMALLEST DEALLOCATION THAT COVERS THE REDEEM. Vault V2 accrues once per transaction; each pull      charges `pa = ceil(pull x rate)` assets and burns `ps = ceil(pa x N / D)` shares, then `N -= ps`,      `D -= pa`. The redeem pays `floor((S - P) x D / N)` out of idle, and idle after the pulls is exactly      `idle + X` (the penalty is paid to the vault itself). `build` walks the cheapest-first candidates      and binary-searches the last partial pull for the smallest `X` with `assetsOut <= idle + X`; a larger      `X` only burns more and pays less. `X = 0` is a plain `redeem(S)`. No feasible `X` reverts      `SHORTFALL`, never a partial exit.ON-CHAIN OUTPUT FLOOR, NO PENALTY CAP. `minAssetsOut` at offset 85 is the least underlying the account      must receive from the whole call: `build` refuses a plan that quotes below it and `_postExecute`      re-checks the MEASURED balance delta, so a rate the curator raises between signing and execution fails      the floor instead of silently burning more. The planner prices the live penalty into its quote and      expresses its tolerance through this one word; a per-adapter cap would be a second knob for the same      thing. Zero disables the floor. The word is committed by the signature over the hook data (source and      destination leaves hash the calldata), so a signer cannot loosen it; `inspect()` stays address-only.`usePrevHookAmount` is REJECTED: a previous outflow publishes underlying, and copying that into a      share field over-burns. This hop is the withdrawal vault-main; the flag is false by construction.FIRST-ACCRUAL ROUNDING. The chain accrues after pull 1 moved its assets adapter -> vault; the Morpho Blue      adapter can report up to 2 wei less than `build` read, so on a vault that is not rate-capped one      penalty burn can exceed the prediction by a single share-wei on an integer boundary, and a FULL exit's      `redeem(S - P)` then reverts (no loss). Partial exits are unaffected.data has the following structure (standard yield-source header + hook-specific), exactly 117 bytes:Those five lines ARE the OMS registry build path, not documentation. `yieldSourceOracleId` must not      match `^placeholder\\d*$` (zero-filled), OMS asset identity reads the field named literally      `yieldSource`, and the sized word is named `shares` so the encoder writes the share integer there.OUTFLOW/ERC4626 because it pays the account, so offset 0 must carry the chain's real oracle id;      a zero or unregistered id reverts `MANAGER_NOT_SET`. Do not place another exit on the same position      after this hook; it has already redeemed.Trusts Vault V2's reentrancy guards, adapter registry and 2% penalty ceiling. amountRoles(bytes).details: `SHARES`: offset 52 is the share input the vault redeems. Needs the `amountMeta` override in      `tooling/hook-enrichment.yaml`, whose default is IN/TOKEN.

build(address,address,bytes).details: Standard build pattern - MUST include preExecute first, postExecute last

params.account: The account to perform executions for (usually an ERC7579 account)
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

returns.executions: Array of Execution structs defining calls to make

params.morpho_: The Morpho Blue singleton for this chain. Adapters pointing anywhere else are skipped.

decodeAmounts(bytes).details: Used to determine the quantity of assets or shares being processed

returns.amounts: Array of amounts (length 1 for single-amount hooks, 2+ for compound hooks)

decodeUsePrevHookAmount(bytes).details: Used to create hook chains where output from one hook becomes input to the next

returns._0: True if the hook should use the previous hook's output amount

getOutAmount(address).details: This is the primary output value used by subsequent hooks

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

returns._0: The amount of tokens (assets or shares) processed

getOutToken(address).details: Used by subsequent hooks to determine what token the previous hook produced      PASSTHROUGH hooks auto-forward the previous hook's outToken      TRANSFORM hooks set this to their specific output token

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

returns._0: The address of the output token, or address(0) if not set

inspect(bytes).details: The vault alone, address-shaped as every inspector in the fleet. The floor word is committed by the      signature over the hook data, not by the allowlist.

postExecute(address,address,bytes).details: Called after the main execution, used to update hook state and calculate results      Sets output values (outAmount, usedShares, etc.) for subsequent hooks

params.account: The account operations were performed for
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

preExecute(address,address,bytes).details: Called before the main execution, used to validate inputs and set execution context      This method may perform state changes to set up the hook's execution state

params.account: The account to perform operations for
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

previewAssetsOut(address,address,uint256.details: Reverts exactly like `build` (SHORTFALL, INSUFFICIENT_SHARES, ...), minus the floor: the caller is      asking what the floor should be. Block-state dependent: a different block accrues differently. Not      an OMS input; the OMS keeps its gross share quote.

replaceCalldataAmounts(bytes,uint256[]).details: Writes bytes 52..83 only: the flag at 84 and the floor word at 85..116 are untouched.

params.amounts: The amounts to replace (must match length from decodeAmounts)
params.data: The data to replace amounts in

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

setExecutionContext(address).details: Used for security validation between preExecute and postExecute calls

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

setOutAmount(uint256,address).details: Used for updating `outAmount` when fees were deducted

params.caller: The caller address for context identification
params.outAmount: The amount of tokens processed by the hook

subtype().details: Used to categorize hooks beyond the basic HookType      For example, a hook might be of type INFLOW but subtype VAULT_DEPOSIT

returns._0: A bytes32 identifier for the specific hook functionality

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Hooks that implement ISuperHookInflowOutflow/ISuperHookOutflow override      _supportsSizingInterface() to return true, which enables three-state detection:      S1: supportsInterface(ISuperHookInflowOutflow) == true → hook has sizing interface      S2: same as S1 but amountRoles(data).length == 0 → authoritatively sizeless      S3: supportsInterface(ISuperHookInflowOutflow) == false → legacy, no sizing interface

SUB_TYPE().notice: The specific subtype identifier for this hook

asset().notice: The primary asset address this hook operates on

build(address,address,bytes).notice: Builds the execution array for the hook operation

decodeAmounts(bytes).notice: Extracts all amounts from the hook's calldata

decodeUsePrevHookAmount(bytes).notice: Determines if this hook should use the amount from the previous hook

description().notice: One-sentence description of what this hook does

executionNonce().notice: Execution nonce for creating unique contexts

getOutAmount(address).notice: The amount of tokens processed by the hook in a given caller context, subject to fees after update

getOutToken(address).notice: The output token address produced by the hook in a given caller context

hookType().notice: The type of hook (NONACCOUNTING, INFLOW, OUTFLOW)

previewAssetsOut(address,address,uint256.notice: The underlying the account would receive for `shares` right now, from the same solver `build` uses

setExecutionContext(address).notice: Sets the caller address that initiated the execution

setOutAmount(uint256,address).notice: Sets the output amount for the hook

spToken().notice: The special token address (if any) associated with this hook's operation

subtype().notice: Returns the specific subtype identification for this hook

usedShares().notice: The number of shares used by this hook's operation
